rationale: Increasing CONFIG_QUEUE_SIZE had no impact on memory cycles, suggesting request concurrency is not the limiting factor. The accelerator is deeply memory-bound (memory cycles account for 99% of total cycles) and generates significant DMA traffic. Increasing CONFIG_SLM_KBYTES from 256 to 1024 provides more local storage, which may allow the accelerator to buffer larger tiles, reducing off-chip memory accesses and lowering accelerator_mem_cycles.
